newsitem.title: USA: Clinton to send Dennis Ross back to Middle East.
newsitem.headline: Clinton to send Dennis Ross back to Middle East.

text.p: President Bill Clinton has asked U.S. negotiator Dennis Ross to return to the Middle East for talks with Israeli and Palestinian leaders, a White House official announced on Tuesday.
"The president has asked ambassodor Dennis Ross to travel to the Middle East tomorrow for consultations on the peace process," said White House spokeswoman Mary Ellen Glynn.
Glynn said Ross would meet with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat.
"It is expected that Ambassador Ross will be back by next weekend to brief the president and Secretary Albright," Glynn said.
The announcement comes in the wake of last Friday's suicide bombing in Tel Aviv, which put serious new strains on peace talks between Israel and Palestinians.

In other efforts to keep the Mideast peace process alive, the United States on Monday also rescheduled a Washington visit for Jordan's King Hussein and pressured Arafat to crack down on Palestinian militants.
